scanNote:
WORKBOOK 8-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (35-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'A Brush with Danger' va to'q sariq '8'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Grammar':
6) 'Match the items in column A to those in column B. Then say which actions happened first and which second in each sentence.' A: 1 After he had finished his homework, 2 They went to bed 3 Rosie had just set off for her doctor's appointment 4 As soon as she had finished vacuuming the carpet, 5 The police arrived at the house | B: a when his receptionist called to cancel it. b she heard the phone ring. c he went for a walk on the beach. d after the burglars had left. e as soon as their guests had left.
7) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect simple.' 1 Henry ...... (return) home by the time Rachel phoned. 2 She ...... (not/go) to bed until she had taken a shower. 3 After Jim ...... (water) the plants, it started to rain. 4 As soon as the plane had landed, the captain ...... (turn off) the seat-belt sign. 5 By the time Vicky woke up, the children ...... (already/make) breakfast. 6 Michelle ...... (wash) the dishes after everyone had gone home. 7 Diana ...... (never/see) an elephant before she went to Africa. 8 Don and Ellen had just finished eating when the doorbell ...... (ring). 9 He didn't read the newspaper until he ...... (take) the dog for a walk. 10 By the time Martin completed his report, everyone ...... (go) home. 11 She ...... (not/want) to watch the film as she had seen it before. 12 We ...... (lock) the door as soon as everyone had left. 13 Tom ...... (already/have) dinner at his friend's house, so she didn't need to cook for him. 14 Anne took Simon to the doctor's because he ...... (cut) his finger.

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'Look at the pictures, then put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past perfect simple or past continuous.' 6 SURAT: 1 telefonda gaplashayotgan ayol (kafe): 'Lisa was having a cup of coffee at a café when someone ...... (call) her on her mobile phone.' 2 sharbat ichayotgan keksa juftlik: 'After they ...... (play) tennis, they had some juice.' 3 bog'da gul ekayotgan erkak: 'Jim ...... (plant) flowers when we arrived.' 4 katta baliq ushlagan ikki erkak: 'Mike and Gary won first prize because they ...... (catch) the biggest fish.' 5 pichan ustida uxlayotgan yigit: 'By 3 pm, Steve ...... (already/fall) asleep.' 6 velosiped tuzatayotgan yigit: 'He ...... (fix) his bicycle when I saw him.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '35'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the items in column A to those in column B. Then say which actions happened first and which second in each sentence.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustundagi bandlarni B ustundagilarga moslang. So'ng har bir gapda qaysi ish birinchi, qaysi ikkinchi bo'lganini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT - IKKI O'TGAN IShDAN
  OLDINGISI (coursebook 56-bet
  qoidasi).

  HAD + V3 = birinchi (oldingi) ish
  PAST SIMPLE = ikkinchi ish

  1 → c: 1-uy vazifasi, 2-sayr
  2 → e: 1-mehmonlar ketdi,
    2-yotdilar
  3 → a: 1-yo'lga chiqdi, 2-qo'ng'iroq
  4 → b: 1-changyutgich, 2-telefon
  5 → d: 1-o'g'rilar ketdi,
    2-politsiya keldi


⚠ BOG'LOVChILAR:

  after, as soon as, by the time,
  when, until, before + had V3.


⚠ 'TO SET OFF':

  = yo'lga chiqmoq.


⚠ 'TO CANCEL':

  = bekor qilmoq.


⚠ 'BURGLARS':

  = o'g'rilar (uyga kiruvchi).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past perfect simple shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE yoki PAST PERFECT?

  ⚠ Gapdagi IKKINChI fe'lga
  qarang: agar u past simple bo'lsa
  (phoned, started, woke up ...),
  OLDINGI ish → PAST PERFECT.
  Agar u past perfect bo'lsa (had
  taken, had landed ...), KEYINGI
  ish → PAST SIMPLE.

  1 had returned (by the time ...
    phoned)
  2 didn't go (until she had taken)
  3 had watered (after ... started)
  4 turned off (as soon as ... had
    landed)
  5 had already made (by the time
    ... woke up)
  6 washed (after ... had gone)
  7 had never seen (before ... went)
  8 rang (had just finished when)
  9 had taken (until - oldin)
  10 had gone (by the time ...
     completed)
  11 didn't want (as she had seen)
  12 locked (as soon as ... had left)
  13 had already had (so ... didn't
     need)
  14 had cut (because - sabab oldin)


⚠ 'BY THE TIME':

  = ... gacha, ... paytga kelib.
  Deyarli har doim + past perfect.


⚠ 'TO WATER THE PLANTS':

  = o'simliklarni sug'ormoq.


⚠ 'THE SEAT-BELT SIGN':

  = xavfsizlik kamari belgisi
  (samolyotda).

items.textEn: Henry ___ (return) home by the time Rachel phoned.
items.hintUz: by the time + past simple → oldingi ish
items.whyUz: ⚠ Rachel qo'ng'iroq qilganda u ALLAQAChON qaytgan edi → past perfect.

items.textEn: She ___ (not/go) to bed until she had taken a shower.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Dush - oldin (had taken); yotish - keyin → past simple.

items.textEn: After Jim ___ (water) the plants, it started to rain.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Sug'orish - oldin → past perfect.

items.textEn: As soon as the plane had landed, the captain ___ (turn off) the seat-belt sign.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Qo'nish - oldin; belgini o'chirish - keyin → past simple.

items.textEn: By the time Vicky woke up, the children ___ (already/make) breakfast.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Uyg'onganda nonushta ALLAQAChON tayyor → past perfect.

items.textEn: Michelle ___ (wash) the dishes after everyone had gone home.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ketish - oldin; yuvish - keyin → past simple.

items.textEn: Diana ___ (never/see) an elephant before she went to Africa.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Afrikaga borishdan OLDIN hech ko'rmagan → past perfect.

items.textEn: Don and Ellen had just finished eating when the doorbell ___ (ring).
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ovqat - oldin; qo'ng'iroq - keyin → past simple (ring → rang).

items.textEn: He didn't read the newspaper until he ___ (take) the dog for a walk.
items.whyUz: ⚠ It bilan sayr - oldin → past perfect.

items.textEn: By the time Martin completed his report, everyone ___ (go) home.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Hisobot tugaganda hamma ALLAQAChON ketgan → past perfect.

items.textEn: She ___ (not/want) to watch the film as she had seen it before.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'rgan - oldin; xohlamaslik - keyin → past simple.

items.textEn: We ___ (lock) the door as soon as everyone had left.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ketish - oldin; qulflash - keyin → past simple.

items.textEn: Tom ___ (already/have) dinner at his friend's house, so she didn't need to cook for him.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ovqat - oldin (already) → past perfect: 'had already had'.

items.textEn: Anne took Simon to the doctor's because he ___ (cut) his finger.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Kesish - oldin (sabab) → past perfect (cut → cut).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past perfect simple or past continuous. 1 woman on the phone at a café; 2 elderly couple with juice after tennis; 3 man planting flowers; 4 two men with a big fish; 5 young man asleep on hay; 6 young man fixing a bicycle.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple, past perfect simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying. 1 kafeda telefondagi ayol; 2 tennisdan keyin sharbat ichayotgan keksa juftlik; 3 gul ekayotgan erkak; 4 katta baliqli ikki erkak; 5 pichanda uxlayotgan yigit; 6 velosiped tuzatayotgan yigit.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh O'TGAN ZAMON (coursebook
  57-bet 15-16-mashqlar).

  PAST CONTINUOUS - davom
    etayotgan fon: 'was planting
    when we arrived', 'was fixing
    when I saw him'
  PAST PERFECT - oldingi tugallangan
    ish: 'after they had played',
    'had caught the biggest fish',
    'had already fallen asleep'
  PAST SIMPLE - qisqa voqea:
    'someone called'


⚠ 'BY 3 PM' + ALREADY:

  = soat 3 ga kelib allaqachon →
  past perfect.


⚠ 'TO FALL ASLEEP':

  = uxlab qolmoq. fall → fallen.


⚠ 'TO WIN FIRST PRIZE':

  = birinchi o'rinni olmoq.
  'because they had caught' - sabab
  OLDIN.


⚠ 'A MOBILE PHONE':

  Brit. = uyali telefon.

items.textEn: Lisa was having a cup of coffee at a café when someone ___ (call) her on her mobile phone.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Fon (was having) + uzib kiruvchi voqea → past simple.

items.textEn: After they ___ (play) tennis, they had some juice.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tennis - oldin; sharbat - keyin → past perfect.

items.textEn: Jim ___ (plant) flowers when we arrived.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Kelganimizda EKAYOTGAN edi (davom etayotgan) → past continuous.

items.textEn: Mike and Gary won first prize because they ___ (catch) the biggest fish.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Baliq tutish - g'alabadan OLDIN → past perfect (catch → caught).

items.textEn: By 3 pm, Steve ___ (already/fall) asleep.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Soat 3 ga kelib allaqachon → past perfect (fall → fallen).

items.textEn: He ___ (fix) his bicycle when I saw him.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'rganimda TUZATAYOTGAN edi → past continuous.

patterns.formula: After/As soon as X had + V3, X + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: After he had finished his homework, he went for a walk.
patterns.exampleUz: U uy vazifasini tugatgach, sayrga chiqdi.

patterns.formula: By the time X + V2, Y had (already) + V3.
patterns.exampleEn: By the time Vicky woke up, the children had already made breakfast.
patterns.exampleUz: Viki uyg'onguncha bolalar allaqachon nonushta tayyorlab bo'lgan edi.

patterns.formula: X had just + V3 when Y + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: Don and Ellen had just finished eating when the doorbell rang.
patterns.exampleUz: Don va Ellen endigina ovqatlanib bo'lgan edi, eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.

patterns.formula: X + V2 because Y had + V3.
patterns.exampleEn: They won first prize because they had caught the biggest fish.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular eng katta baliqni tutgani uchun birinchi o'rinni olishdi.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ OT = FE'L: water, plant, phone, vacuum
groups.explanationUz: Betdagi so'zlar ham ot, ham fe'l.
